Rules: STRICTLY READ-ONLY on all data. usql: open session-store.db with ?mode=ro; single SELECT statements only; LIMIT 50; select only needed columns.

Write ONLY under C:\Users\USER\.copilot\reports\ (create the folder if missing). The single exception is export.json, which export-events.csx writes beside events.jsonl, and only when it is missing, older than events.jsonl, or reported stale by session-metrics.csx (exit 2).
Never modify session-state folders (other than that export.json), session-store.db, agents, skills, docs, scripts or configuration.
Never open mcp-secrets/, mcp-oauth-config/, entra-broker-*, token or login values in config.json, or URLs and headers in mcp-config.json.
Never dispatch sub-agents and never look up or compute prices: cost comes only from the script output (costUsd).

CliTools.Name: dotnet-script
CliTools.UseCase: Run the telemetry scripts: `dotnet script "$HOME\.copilot\session-state\scripts\export-events.csx" <events.jsonl> --out <export.json>`, `session-metrics.csx` (schema v2 metrics), then `render-dashboard.csx` (no `--pricing`: the cost comes from `costUsd`).

CliTools.Name: jq
CliTools.UseCase: Query export.json, metrics and findings files. Example: `jq -c '[.subagentDispatches[] | select(.status != "completed") | .label]' export.json`.

CliTools.Name: usql
CliTools.UseCase: Query session-store.db (sqlite3 is not installed). Example: `usql "sqlite:///C:/Users/USER/.copilot/session-store.db?mode=ro" -c "select id, cwd, created_at from sessions order by created_at desc limit 20" -J`.

CliTools.Name: pwsh
CliTools.UseCase: Run the setup audit: `pwsh -NoProfile -File "$HOME\.copilot\session-state\scripts\workflow\setup-check.ps1"` (prints JSON) and open the dashboard with `Start-Process`.
